en.TELEMETRY_TOGGLE: IF YOU TURN THIS ON YOUR GAME MIGHT LAG MORE but it will help make the scripts better by sending random information to a text
en.OPEN_UI_PC_DESC: Press G on your keyboard to open the UI on PC if it disappears when minimizing the UI.
en.DISCORD_PROMO: Please join the official Discord server for more scripts! If you are a content creator, make a video on this script and we will post it.
en.DISCORD_INVITE_COPIED: The Discord invite was copied to your clipboard!
en.YOUTUBE_LINK_COPIED: The YouTube link was copied to your clipboard!
en.DISCORD_LOAD_FAILED:
Failed to load Discord data.
Your executor may not support everything in this script.
en.CONTENT_CREATOR_HOME: Upload a video about this script and DM Ringta in Discord to get the Content Creator role. Your video may be featured in the showcase channel, giving you free views and access to private channels. You do not need many views or subscribers—just make a good video and put in some effort.
en.TELEMETRY_DESC: Only enable this if you want to help improve the script. It may cause lag because it sends random information, so use it briefly if you want to test it.
en.TESTING_DESC: If you play this game often and enjoy testing things, DM Ringta with suggestions or ideas for this script.
en.BRING_RANDOM_ITEMS_DESC: Brings random items toward your Roblox character, such as gold bars. Tracks progress and updates the status below.
en.AUTO_HIT_WEAPON_DESC: Automatically hit enemies with your weapon.
en.TRAIN_KILL_AURA_DESC: Kill many mobs while riding the train.
en.BIG_KILL_HITBOX: The large kill hitbox was activated!
en.NORMAL_KILL_HITBOX: The normal kill hitbox was restored.
en.CONDUCTOR_SEAT_SUCCESS: Successfully sat in the conductor seat!
en.TELEPORT_FEATURES_DESC: The teleport features below require a saddled horse, except teleporting to the train and fort. These features are in beta; you can also use the Cowboy class to get a horse.
en.NO_OBJECT_MODELS: ObjectModels was not found in the workspace.
en.NO_CRATE: No crate was found in ObjectModels.
en.CRATE_BUGGED: The crate is bugged. You must open it yourself.
en.CRATE_OPENED: Crate opened! Waiting for the saddle...
en.SADDLE_NOT_APPEARED: The saddle did not appear after opening the crate.
en.NO_HORSE_OPENING_CRATE: No horse found. Opening the crate...
en.BRINGING_HORSE_SADDLE: Bringing the horse and saddle. Dragging...
en.HORSE_SADDLE_FAILED: Could not bring the horse or saddle.
en.WAITING_SADDLE: Waiting for the saddle to attach...
en.SADDLE_ATTACH_FAILED: The saddle did not attach. Try again.
en.HORSE_SEAT_NOT_FOUND: The horse was saddled, but its VehicleSeat was not found.
en.THIRD_PERSON_DESC: Lets you zoom out and see your Roblox character (beta).
en.CAMERA_MODULE_FAILED: The camera module could not be loaded. Does your executor support require?
en.THIRD_PERSON_FORCED: Third-person mode is now forced on.
en.THIRD_PERSON_RELEASED: Third-person mode is no longer forced.
en.FLY_REQUIREMENT: This only works when you are sitting on a chair or turret.
en.TRAIN_STATUS_EMPTY:
Time: Not found yet
Distance: Not found yet
en.OUTPOST_SEAT_SUCCESS: You were teleported to the nearest seat at the outpost!
en.OUTPOST_NO_SEAT: Teleported, but no nearby seat was found. Try again.
en.BONDS_STATUS_UNKNOWN:
Bonds currently: Not sure yet
Bonds gained this run: 0
en.BONDS_UNAVAILABLE:
Bond data is unavailable.
Bonds gained this run: 0
en.BONDS_STATUS:
Bonds currently: %s
Bonds gained this run: %s
en.PREMIUM_BOND_FARM_DESC: Join the Ringta Discord and buy access for 500 Robux, make a video about this script, or boost the server.
en.PREMIUM_LOCKED: Premium only — boost the server or create content.
en.EXECUTOR_UNSUPPORTED: Your executor may not support this feature.
en.BOND_FARM_STARTED: Farm started. Watch the YouTube video if you have not already.
en.INFINITE_ITEMS_DESC: This feature can spawn infinite items selected from the dropdown. Turn it on to use it. Premium is required; boost the server or become a Content Creator by making a polished video.
en.INFINITE_ACCESS_DENIED: You must be a Content Creator or Discord booster to use Infinite Get Items. A free release is coming soon!
en.ECS_LOAD_FAILED: ECS or the Store remote failed to load. Your executor may not support require().
en.BRING_ITEMS_DESC: This feature may not work on some executors. Watch Ringta's YouTube video for details; valuables and bonds may require Premium.
en.BRING_VALUABLES_DESC: Bring gold, silver, and other valuables. Premium only.
en.BRING_ONCE_DESC: Each item is brought once per toggle session.
en.BRING_STARTED: Started. Items will teleport to you; this may take a second.
en.BRING_WEAPONS_AMMO_DESC: Bring weapons, ammunition, and explosives. Free.
en.SELECT_WEAPONS_AMMO_DESC: Choose which weapons or ammunition to bring.
en.BRING_BONDS_DESC: Bring all bonds without auto-collect. Premium only.
en.BRING_BONDS_NO_COLLECT_DESC: Bring each bond once per toggle session.
en.BONDS_STARTED: Started. Bonds will teleport to you; this may take a second.
en.BRING_CANNON_DESC: Brings a cannon. Only works when near a cannon, such as near Fort Constitution.
en.CANNON_SUCCESS: Successfully teleported and sat in the nearest cannon seat.
en.CANNON_FAILED_DESC: Unable to find the cannon or bond location.
en.CONTENT_CREATOR_VIDEO_DESC:
Upload a video or short about the script on YouTube or TikTok to be featured as a Content Creator!

- DM Ringta on Discord after uploading
- Your video or channel may be shared in the community showcase
- Get the Content Creator role and access private channels
- Each week, a random uploader may win a prize
You do not need many subscribers or views—just make an effort!

Top Content Creator requires at least 10,000 views on one script video.
en.CREATORS_LOAD_FAILED: Unable to load the content creators list.
en.SCRIPT_LOADING_DESC: This script may take a little while to load.
